correctness.rationale: The nested projection-DPP construction has an exact omitted-coordinate Markov law; the resulting oblique and orthogonal CSSP errors are explicit, the hierarchical limit yields the full product factor, and independent numerical checks reproduce the formulas.

originality.rationale: The motivating paper proves the product upper bound and tightness only for a different fixed-initial-set conditional bound. Classical one-shot ARP/DPP and d+1 volume-sampling sharpness are excluded; no prior full-MSARP product sharpness theorem was located in the checked source and related searches.

value.rationale: The theorem shows that the multiplicative stage penalty, including the 2^d singleton-stage regime, is a genuine worst-case expected CSSP effect even with exact dominant-subspace information and orthogonal projection, so improved universal guarantees require additional assumptions or a modified algorithm.
